model: Shiu 2024 LIF on MaleCNS v1.0, w_syn 0.17875 mV, Brian2 2.9.0 cython, store/restore path

level_notes.ir94e: Four levels; the characterization showed high and very_high not distinguishable, so they are merged into 'high' = 200 Hz. Ir94e is not exposed in the v1 encoder; the v1 lookup uses the ir94e = none slice. Included so v2 does not need a second grid run.
level_notes.water: Five encoder levels are kept, but low and medium share one grid cell (both 60 Hz) because the model cannot separate weak water drives: the fixed-path recheck (docs/fixed_path_recheck.md) found water 60 -> 120 Hz indistinguishable on every curve (alone, and as a modifier at sugar 60/100/200). 60 Hz is visible only as a helper to sugar (sugar x water surface); 180 and 240 Hz drive MN9 alone. The grid runner deduplicates identical Hz vectors, so the grid is 5 x 5 x 4 x 4 = 400 unique cells; lookups resolve level names by Hz.
level_notes.sugar: 25 Hz gives 0 Hz MN9 in this model, so the former 25/50 levels were replaced; threshold is near 40 Hz, saturation near 90 Hz MN9.
level_notes.readout: left MN9 (720575940660219265) per stim_protocol.json; right recorded

mn11.statistic: 30-trial mean of per-trial mean over the male MN11D cells (count 3 from the cells file)

state_rule.ties: Not a state; existing MN9 tie handling unchanged.
state_rule.meaning: Owner-designed threshold categories of model outputs; product wording and site integration are Phase 3 decisions.

extra_statistics.mn11d: Mean and population SD over 30 per-trial three-cell mean rates
extra_statistics.mn11v: Mean and population SD over 30 per-trial two-cell mean rates
extra_statistics.cem: Mean and population SD over 30 per-trial six-cell mean rates
extra_statistics.mn9_r: Mean and population SD of the secondary R16949 rate; aliases of mn9_right_*.
extra_statistics.state: Threshold applied to unrounded 30-trial means; rounding does not change any state

product_commitments: The male brain uses MaleCNS v1.0 with connections of >= 5 synapses and a synaptic weight of 0.65 x Shiu's (0.17875 mV), a calibration taken from an independent project (blendi-remade/fly-brain-minecraft) and replicated by us; the female uses FlyWire v783, all connections, Shiu's 0.275 mV.
The male is stimulated bilaterally with Tastekin-typed GRN sets; the female unilaterally with Shiu's sets. The two flies do not share one stimulus protocol.

The male brain misses one of our four behavioural gates: bitter alone at 25 Hz gives 1.07 Hz on MN9 against our 1.0 Hz limit (docs/malecns_phase0.md, M1j); invisible in the product below the 5 Hz activity threshold, but recorded.

When the two flies disagree, the cause may be sex, reconstruction, cell typing, sign assignment, weight, or stimulus protocol; this pipeline cannot separate them. This sentence appears on the result page whenever they disagree, not only in the README.
field_note: mn9_mean and mn9_left_* are the primary L10331 (XLSX L); mn9_right_* and mn9_r_* are the secondary R16949 (XLSX R); the secondary does not decide
